description: Rory’s break from Yale strains her bond with Lorelai, while Luke and Lorelai’s engagement is tested by family discoveries, delay and increasingly poor communication.

s06e01.description: Lorelai accepts Luke’s marriage proposal while remaining estranged from Rory, who begins living with Emily and Richard and faces the consequences of stealing the yacht.

s06e02.description: Rory starts community service under court supervision, while Lorelai adopts Paul Anka and home renovations become chaotic once T.J. decides he is qualified to help.

s06e03.description: Lorelai hesitates to set a wedding date while Rory settles into life away from Yale, Logan returns and Lane’s band comes home from touring.

s06e04.description: Sookie appoints Lorelai and Rory as godmothers to her children in a transparent attempt to force the estranged pair into the same room and conversation.

s06e05.description: Rory successfully stages a large DAR fundraiser, but Richard’s confrontation with Mitchum Huntzberger finally makes him question whether Rory has been hiding from her own future.

s06e06.description: Taylor revives Stars Hollow’s historical street names, leaving the Dragonfly with an embarrassing new address while Rory’s increasingly controlled life with Emily begins to chafe.

s06e07.description: Emily throws Rory an elaborate twenty-first birthday party, replacing the Atlantic City celebration Rory and Lorelai had planned for years and underscoring their continuing estrangement.

s06e08.description: Jess returns with a published book and bluntly challenges Rory over abandoning Yale, forcing her to confront how far her life has drifted from what she wanted.

s06e09.description: Rory leaves her grandparents’ house, returns to Yale and finally reconciles with Lorelai, while Luke learns that a twelve-year-old girl named April may be his daughter.

s06e10.description: The Gilmores reunite for Thanksgiving, but Luke keeps April’s existence secret from Lorelai while Lane’s band prepares for an important showcase.

s06e11.description: Lorelai unexpectedly finds the wedding dress she wants and begins serious planning, while Lane moves back home after her breakup with Zack and remains deeply unhappy.

s06e12.description: Lorelai accidentally discovers Luke has a daughter and realizes he has kept the news from her for weeks, while Paris’s tyrannical newspaper management alienates her staff.

s06e13.description: Rory and Logan save the Yale Daily News after the staff revolts against Paris, and a chaotic Friday dinner finally lets the Gilmores air months of accumulated grievances.

s06e14.description: The newspaper staff removes Paris as editor and chooses Rory to replace her, while Lorelai’s parents meet Luke again and the wedding delay becomes increasingly difficult to ignore.

s06e15.description: A Valentine weekend with Rory and Logan at Martha’s Vineyard exposes Luke’s irritability and insecurity, while Mitchum’s arrival abruptly reminds Logan of the obligations waiting for him.

s06e16.description: At Honor’s wedding, Rory learns Logan slept with several bridesmaids during their separation and feels betrayed, while Zack publicly asks Lane to marry him.

s06e17.description: Zack seeks Mrs. Kim’s approval to marry Lane and unexpectedly wins her cooperation, while Lorelai and Rory insist their troubled relationships are somehow perfectly fine.

s06e18.description: Luke takes April’s class trip to Philadelphia and visits Jess, while Rory also sees Jess and increasingly resents Logan’s drinking, recklessness and privileged self-pity.

s06e19.description: Lane and Zack marry in a day combining Korean Buddhist and Christian traditions, while Lorelai’s drunken wedding speech exposes how abandoned she feels by Luke.

s06e20.description: Logan is critically injured during a dangerous stunt, while Luke struggles to host April’s birthday party until Lorelai steps in and transforms it into a success.

s06e21.description: Lorelai drives Emily after eye surgery and admits the wedding may never happen, while Rory cares for recovering Logan and Sookie discovers an unwanted crop growing on her property.

s06e22.description: Logan leaves for London after graduating, and Lorelai finally gives Luke an ultimatum about marriage; when he hesitates, she ends the relationship and turns to Christopher.
